name: Narssia Trixie
original_name: ナーシャ・トリクスィ
source:
Around 14 years old, half-elf.
Star Sign: Taurus
Occupation: Shaman

A half-elf spirit user.
An essential straight man of the the party, but at times she can also be a little dumb.
Unfitting her cute looks she has a sharp tongue.
She has no mercy with her verbal jabs.
